_note: turn-end guard registration example (wake system v2, docs/wake-loop-v2-design.md §8).
MERGE the two entries under hooks below into the hooks object of your settings.json (user-level ~/.claude/settings.json or
project-level <project>/.claude/settings.json). Do not overwrite your existing settings with this whole file.
Each of the two entries has its own job:
- Stop: decides whether stopping is allowed. When an agent/run is in flight but no watcher is armed, it returns decision:block to prevent a blind stop.
- UserPromptSubmit: marks manual mode (user present), so the guard does not block stops during user interaction.
The command uses `python3 -m aiteam.hooks.turn_end_guard` (aiteam is installed with pip -e, see install.py).
For plugin distribution, you can instead use python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/turn_end_guard.py".
Hard constraints: the guard fails open (any exception lets the stop through); an explicit user request to stop always lets it through (stop keywords + manual marker
as a double safeguard); stop_hook_active recursion protection; automatic release after consecutive blocks reach the cap. All built in.
